result.title: Zendesk Official Pricing and Add-On Tiers
result.full_text:
DOCUMENT ID: DOC-ZD-02
TITLE: Zendesk Official Pricing and Add-On Tiers
VENDOR: Zendesk
SOURCE TYPE: pricing_page
PUBLISHED: 2026-01-10
TARGET ENTITY: Zendesk AI

PRICING STRUCTURE:
Zendesk operates on a hybrid per-seat and add-on commercial model:
- Suite Team (Entry Tier): $55 per agent/month (billed annually). Includes basic ticketing, email/chat channels, standard pre-built bots, and foundational intent detection.
- Suite Growth: $89 per agent/month (billed annually). Includes multiple ticket forms, light agents, and self-service customer portals.
- Suite Professional: $115 per agent/month (billed annually). Full business hours, custom routing, and advanced reporting.
- Suite Enterprise: $169 per agent/month (billed annually). Sandbox environments, custom agent roles, and dynamic ticket workspaces.

ADVANCED AI ADD-ON:
- Pricing: $50 per agent/month flat add-on fee across Suite Professional and Enterprise tiers.
- Included in Advanced AI: Autonomous generative bot responses, intent and sentiment suggestions on agent ticket views, intelligent triage rules, and macro suggestions.
- Enterprise Custom Contract: For organizations over 500 agents, volume discounting applies, scaling down to $35 per agent/month for the Advanced AI tier. Minimum annual commitment of $150,000 required.
- High Volume Deflection Fees: No per-resolution fee is charged for standard native automated bot deflections up to 10,000 deflections/month. Overage is billed at $0.15 per automated deflection.

result.title: Intercom Fin AI Agent Capabilities & Commercial Model
result.full_text:
DOCUMENT ID: DOC-INT-02
TITLE: Intercom Fin AI Agent Capabilities & Commercial Model
VENDOR: Intercom
SOURCE TYPE: pricing_page
PUBLISHED: 2026-02-01
TARGET ENTITY: Intercom Fin AI

COMMERCIAL MODEL AND PRICING:
Intercom uses a core seat price combined with a consumption-based pricing model for Fin AI:
- Essential Tier: $39 per seat/month (billed annually). Geared toward early-stage companies and smaller support desks.
- Advanced Tier: $99 per seat/month. Includes custom workflows, round-robin assignment, and multilingual support.
- Expert Tier: $139 per seat/month. Advanced permissions, SSO, and real-time workload management.

FIN AI RESOLUTION PRICING & PERFORMANCE:
- Cost per Resolution: Intercom charges a flat fee of $0.99 per successful automated resolution. A resolution is counted only when the customer explicitly confirms the issue was solved or ceases the conversation without escalating to a human agent.
- Claimed Resolution Rate: Intercom official documentation asserts that Fin AI achieves a verified 50% automated resolution rate across inbound customer queries without human intervention.
- Copilot Add-On: Fin AI Copilot for human reps is priced at $35 per agent/month.

result.title: TechOps Field Benchmark: Real-world AI Resolution Metrics and Cost Analysis
result.full_text:
DOCUMENT ID: DOC-ANA-03
TITLE: TechOps Field Benchmark: Real-world AI Resolution Metrics and Cost Analysis
VENDOR: TechOps Advisory
SOURCE TYPE: analyst_report
PUBLISHED: 2026-02-10
TARGET ENTITY: Intercom Fin AI / Multi-vendor Benchmark

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & INDEPENDENT TEST RESULTS:
TechOps conducted a rigorous 90-day double-blind evaluation of generative customer support agents across 35,000 live customer interactions in SaaS and fintech environments.

CONTRADICTION ANALYSIS - INTERCOM FIN AI:
- Official Vendor Marketing Claim (DOC-INT-02): Intercom advertises a 50% automated resolution rate at a fixed consumption cost of $0.99 per resolution.
- Field Empirical Measurement: In controlled testing against 12,000 real-world inquiries, Fin AI achieved an effective autonomous resolution rate of only 31%. Furthermore, when accounting for escalated re-opens and multi-turn channel transitions, the effective cost per resolved issue was calculated at $1.50 per resolution.
- Analytical Note: While Fin AI displays high conversational fluency, customers frequently required human escalation for multi-part billing disputes and authentication tasks.

CROSS-VENDOR RESOLUTION RATES (MEASURED):
- Zendesk Advanced AI: 32% measured deflection rate.
- Ada Support: 41% measured deflection rate.
- Forethought: 36% measured deflection rate.
- Freshworks Freddy: 27% measured deflection rate.

AUTOMATE AI ADD-ON:
- Priced at $1.00 per automated interaction.
- E-commerce self-service flows included.

ENTERPRISE CUSTOM TIERS:
- For organizations exceeding 10,000 tickets/month, custom high-volume ticket blocks are available.
[Note: Gorgias does not disclose public pricing for custom LLM model fine-tuning or contractual Enterprise SLA uptime percentages in published documentation.]

final_report.executive_summary: This market intelligence brief evaluates the competitive landscape, commercial structures, and architectural paradigms across enterprise AI-powered customer support platforms. Enterprise spend expanded 34% YoY to $4.8B in 2025, driven by the structural transition from deterministic dialog trees to autonomous generative reasoning agents. Commercial models are sharply bifurcated: fixed per-seat add-ons (Zendesk at $50/agent/mo) provide budget predictability, while variable consumption models (Intercom Fin at $0.99/res, Salesforce Agentforce at $2.00/conv) tie spend to deflection volume. Empirical field benchmarking reveals notable divergence between vendor marketing resolution claims (50%) and measured real-world deflection (31%-41%), emphasizing the critical need for human-in-the-loop oversight and rigorous governance.

market_overview.category_definition: AI-powered customer support platforms delivering autonomous multi-channel issue deflection, agent copilots, and intelligent triage.
key_drivers: Shift from rigid dialog-tree bots to LLM reasoning agents grounded in internal documentation.
High enterprise demand for measurable per-resolution ROI and deflection metrics.
Stringent governance mandates for PII redaction and indirect prompt injection defenses.
